source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Enter diagnostic test mode
steps.body: Activate diagnostic test mode and advance past saved fault codes. Machine fully assembled.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate diagnostic test mode and advance past saved fault codes. Machine fully assembled.

steps.title: Door open short check
steps.body: Open dryer door. If beep + alphanumeric display immediately, short exists in moisture sensor system — inspect harness and sensor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open dryer door. If beep + alphanumeric display immediately, short exists in moisture sensor system — inspect harness and sensor.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Repair short in moisture sensor harness or replace sensor/MCE as needed.

steps.title: Wet cloth bridge test
steps.body: Bridge lint screen housing sensor strips with wet cloth. Beep + software revision on console = pass.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Bridge lint screen housing sensor strips with wet cloth. Beep + software revision on console = pass.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Sensor failed wet-cloth test — bench test at disconnected harness.

steps.title: Bench moisture sensor
steps.body: Disconnect power. Remove toe panel, disconnect sensor from harness. Measure outermost contacts on cable with red MOVs. Replace sensor/harness if shorted.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Remove toe panel, disconnect sensor from harness. Measure outermost contacts on cable with red MOVs. Replace sensor/harness if shorted.

steps.title: Repair moisture short
steps.oemOutcome: Clear short or replace moisture sensor / wire harness / MCE.

steps.title: Moisture sensor verified
steps.oemOutcome: Moisture sensor responds in diagnostic and bench checks.
